stem.text: Which statement about two nuclei that are isotopes of the same element is correct?

A.text: The nuclei each have the same acceleration when in the same uniform electric field.

B.text: The nuclei each have the same number of neutrons.

C.text: The nuclei each have the same number of nucleons.

D.text: Uncharged atoms containing the nuclei each have the same number of electrons.
